Workflow type can be AM_APPLICATION_CREATION, AM_SUBSCRIPTION_CREATION,   AM_USER_SIGNUP, AM_APPLICATION_REGISTRATION_PRODUCTION, AM_APPLICATION_REGISTRATION_SANDBOX.
